svg.title: A — Shaded Irish Sitka spruce forest floor concept
svg.desc: Original schematic: dim plantation trunks above variegated needle litter, twigs and localized moss; zoomed texture study and rejected uniform alternatives. Concept only, not observed Unity.
svg.text: CCF / SCENARIO ONE / ECOLOGICAL LOOK DEVELOPMENT

g.text: Dark, needle-led; not bare and not lush
LAYERED VISUAL: needle mat / fine twig fall / subdued soil / discontinuous moss
No uniform green stamp, no circular tree disc
Shape distribution is illustrative, NOT cover %

svg.text: No fine litter scale; looks like painted soil
Incorrect as a universal dense-Sitka default
Not a measured vegetation map or a texture bake master. Existing Compact30 ground geometry and H1/path masks are not changed.
